title: Friday · feelings, needs and finishing our learning
arrival: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms. Get your materials ready.
note: Health: feelings and needs before French, with Nevermoor only if time. French 9:35–10:35, snack after recess, PE 11:10–11:50. Afternoon laptops are booked: finish first-term work and SpacesEDU postings first. Introduce the inquiry briefly only if enough students are ready. No separate art or fractions lesson today, and no new inquiry submission deadline. Leadership work meeting after school 2:45–3:30 for participating students.

blocks.title: Welcome and attendance
blocks.firstAction: Answer attendance, then hand in forms.

blocks.title: Health · feelings and needs
blocks.firstAction: Open your feelings-and-needs work and find where you stopped.
blocks.notes: Continue and finish the current Health work before starting anything new. Use fictional situations to name a feeling and a need, practise a respectful request, and consider what to do when someone says no or stop. Personal sharing is optional. Use talk, drawing or writing as appropriate. If the Health work leaves time before French, continue Nevermoor from our actual stopping point. Maths is not scheduled today; fractions will likely begin next week.
studentSteps: Show a feeling, a need and a respectful request.
Check your work and ask for help if needed.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: PE
blocks.firstAction: Listen to today’s activity and safety directions.
blocks.notes: Use the current teacher-selected activity and clear non-contact rules; do not assume dodgeball.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.

blocks.title: Quiet reset
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading or another calm activity.

blocks.title: SpacesEDU · finish first-term work
blocks.firstAction: Open the unfinished work your teacher has asked you to complete.
blocks.notes: Friday afternoon laptops are confirmed booked. Prioritise required first-term work and existing SpacesEDU postings. Finish the work, choose clear evidence, improve the reflection and check the existing instructions. Support students to complete their next useful step rather than starting a new major task.
studentSteps: Add clear evidence and explain your learning.
Check the instructions, then save or submit as your teacher directs.

blocks.title: Continue postings · inquiry if ready
blocks.firstAction: Continue your SpacesEDU work until your next step is complete.
blocks.notes: SpacesEDU remains the priority. Only if enough students are ready, give a short introduction to the better-world inquiry: explore issues students care about, show how two countries can be compared and collect questions. No full inquiry launch, new compulsory post or new deadline. Do not require a SchoolAI Space or assume one exists. Otherwise use the whole block to finish existing work.
studentSteps: Keep working on your current posting.
If your teacher starts the inquiry introduction, notice an issue you care about.
Share a question and keep it for a later lesson.

blocks.title: Save, tidy and move
blocks.firstAction: Save your work, complete classroom jobs and join a short movement break when directed.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and prepare for dismissal.

backups: If laptops or SpacesEDU are unavailable, finish existing work or draft reflections on paper; Friday afternoon laptops are booked.
Continue from actual class progress; this plan is not a claim that earlier lessons were completed.
No new homework or posting deadline is added.
